description.html: Gecko Nutrition Wild Berry is a complete powdered diet made in Germany, created for crested geckos and other fruit-eating reptiles. This variety brings an intense, natural bouquet of wild berries - strawberry, raspberry, blackberry and blueberry - offering an exciting mix of sweet and mildly tart flavors. Banana makes up 30% of the formula and provides a rich source of energy and potassium, while insects (black soldier fly larvae, mealworms and crickets) at 11% provide complete proteins and essential amino acids. Wild berries are naturally rich in antioxidants, vitamin C and fiber, which support healthy digestion and a stronger immune system. The formula is enriched with additional vitamins and minerals that support proper growth, bone development and vitality. Crude protein content is 25.7% and calcium 2%, ensuring an optimal nutritional profile for everyday use.

Prepare a meal by mixing one part powder with two parts water (1:2 ratio) until you reach a smooth, creamy consistency. Put the prepared mixture in a shallow dish and place it in the terrarium in the evening, since geckos are active at night. We recommend feeding 2-3 times a week in the evening. Remove uneaten food after 24 hours to keep the terrarium fresh and hygienic. Alongside the complete diet, you can occasionally offer live insects as extra enrichment. Store the unopened powder in a cool, dry place, protected from direct sunlight.
Crested geckos and other fruit-eating reptiles.
